evidence: The film-growth experiments were carried out in a flow-type, hot-wall, ALD reactor F120. LaO x film growth was examined in the temperature range 200–400 °C. The films were grown from La[N(SiMe 3)2]3 and H 2O on n-Si(100) or p-Si(100) covered with a SiO 2 layer (1.2–2 nm thick), and on borosilicate glass substrates. In some cases, the silicon substrates were etched prior to deposition in 1 % HF aqueous solution for ca. 30 s, without further rinsing in deionized water. La[N(SiMe 3)2]3 was transferred into the reactor under inert atmosphere from a glove box by means of a special transfer tube held under argon atmosphere. Inside the ALD reactor, La[N(SiMe 3)2]3 was evaporated from an open boat in the temperature range 115–140 °C.
